header.note: integers x scale = metres; x east, y north, local TM centred on P0 (origin.json). Rings flat [x0,y0,...], no closing vertex, exterior CCW, holes CW. Everything clipped to a 3 km circle. Sea = absence of areas.land.
header.simplify_tolerance_m: buildings: foveated, tol = clamp(r/2667 - 0.05, 0.1, 0.5) m where r = distance from P0 (keeps error incl. quantisation < 0.3 px for any P0-centred view on 1600 px); roadbed 0.1 m; parks/water/landcover 0.5 m; land 0.25 m
source: NYC Planimetric Roadbed (i36f-5ih7), Open Space Parks (y6ja-fw4f), Hydrography (pjs3-c3z5)
OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL): coastline (land), parks, water, landcover, road centrelines, park paths

schema.buildings: [h_roof, ground_elev, bin, polygons]  polygons=[[outer,hole..],..]; sorted by height
schema.roads: [class, name_index, width, oneway, bridge(1)/tunnel(-1), line]  width = median cross-section of NYC roadbed polygons, else class default
schema.areas.<kind>: list of polygons; kinds: land, park, grass, wood, pitch, water (inland), roadbed
